primary_contrast_1: M34 signed risk: osteoblast lineage versus immune
primary_contrast_2: M34 negative-loading expression: immune versus osteoblast lineage
locked_single_cell_interpretation: Across six biological dogs, the M34 signed risk-oriented score was consistently higher in osteoblast-lineage than immune compartments, while the negative-loading component was consistently higher in immune than osteoblast-lineage cells. Because 153 of 155 detected M34 genes have negative loadings, M34 is best interpreted as an inverse immune-lineage or immune-depletion/exclusion axis.

locked_single_cell_interpretation: Across six biological dogs, M40 signed and positive-loading scores were consistently higher in cycling than non-cycling osteoblasts. Together with high scores in cycling T-cell and osteoclast populations, M40 is a broad cycling/proliferation axis with clear tumor-lineage enrichment rather than an osteoblast-specific program.
